name: vawe-skills
description: Skills for vawe, the open-source HTML to video framework for coding agents.

plugins.name: vawe
plugins.description: Six skills that take a coding agent from a film request to a rendered mp4 with vawe: start, brief, page, transitions, critique, reference. They run inside a vawe checkout.

plugins.name: vawe-agent
plugins.description: The vawe agent and its checked tools: an MCP server for each step of a film, a hook that blocks hand-made film writes and raw ffmpeg or Chrome, a /vawe command and the vawe skills. Needs a vawe checkout or package with Node 22 and ffmpeg.
